items.title: TaMo PV posts Rs 5,531 crore Q2 loss, revenue rises 34%
items.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles has reported a consolidated loss of ₹5,531 crore for the second quarter. Revenue has increased by 34% to ₹96,920 crore, though it slightly missed market estimates. The loss marks the company's steepest in the last 22 quarters following a profitable year earlier. The domestic passenger vehicle segment achieved record quarterly revenue, primarily due to increased sales volumes.

items.title: Grasim Industries Q2 profit triples to 2,306 cr, revenue up 33%
items.description: Grasim Industries reported a profit of ₹2,306 crore for the September quarter, nearly tripling year-on-year. Revenue reached an all-time high of ₹12,747 crore, indicating strong growth across core businesses. The cellulosic fibres segment saw a 29% revenue growth, while the decorative paints business experienced a 35% increase. In contrast, the chemicals business faced challenges with declining profitability. Overall, there was a notable disparity in standalone and consolidated financial results.

items.title: Zetwerk Q2 net loss widens 43%, revenue increases 18%
items.description: Zetwerk reported a 43% increase in net loss to ₹88.11 crore during the September quarter, compared to last year. Revenue from operations rose 18% to ₹4,599.36 crore, a decline from the previous quarter's growth. Losses from continuing operations widened significantly while the discontinued business saw a reduced loss. The company faced increased finance and employee stock option costs contributing to its net loss.

items.title: Eicher Motors Q2 net profit rises 15% to Rs 1,573 crore, misses estimates
items.description: Eicher Motors reported a 15% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to ₹1,573 crore in the September quarter, missing analysts’ estimate of ₹1,626 crore as higher raw material costs offset gains from strong sales. Revenue rose 20% to ₹7,422 crore, while EBITDA increased 16% to a record ₹1,760 crore.

items.title: Regaal Resources Q2 net profit up 39pc to Rs 23.18 cr
items.description: Regaal Resources Ltd has reported a substantial 39 percent rise in net profit for the second quarter of FY27, achieving Rs 23.18 crore compared to last year’s Rs 16.71 crore. Despite a slight 1 percent drop in total income to Rs 316.88 crore, the company managed to reduce expenses from Rs 297.9 crore to Rs 285.16 crore.

items.title: Ennature Bio Pharma posts Rs 5 cr PAT in Q2
items.description: Ennature Bio Pharma has achieved a profit after tax of Rs 4.89 crore in the second quarter of FY27, a notable turnaround from a loss of Rs 1.28 crore last year. The quarterly revenue surged to Rs 78.46 crore, compared to Rs 54.14 crore the previous year. Furthermore, the company reported an EBITDA of Rs 10.34 crore, marking its first results post-demerger from India Glycols Ltd.

items.title: DEE Development Engineers Q2 profit rises 32% to Rs 23 cr
items.description: DEE Development Engineers Ltd reported a remarkable 31.8% increase in consolidated profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, rising to Rs 23.45 crore from Rs 17.79 crore the previous year. This growth was supported by a revenue boost to Rs 292.98 crore, primarily driven by advancements in the piping and fittings segment, reflecting their strategic pivot towards high-margin nuclear piping solutions.

items.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
items.description: RHI Magnesita has reported a remarkable surge in net profit, soaring to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. The consolidated revenues experienced a modest increase, hitting Rs 1,038.26 crore this period. Additionally, overall expenses decreased to Rs 953.06 crore compared to the last year. EBITDA saw a 30 percent growth, reflecting operational enhancements despite challenging economic conditions.

items.title: Sammaan Capital Q2 Results: Net profit rises to Rs 312 crore, AUM up 5% QoQ to Rs 59,188 crore
items.description: Sequentially, the company’s net profit increased over 28% quarter on quarter from Rs 243 crore reported in the first quarter of FY27. The non banking financial company’s assets under management (AUM) meanwhile increased over 5% QoQ to Rs 59,188 crore as at the end of the September quarter, from Rs 56,239 crore at the end of the June quarter.

items.title: Patanjali Foods Q2 Results: Net profit falls 19% YoY to Rs 420 crore, revenue rises 16%
items.description: The FMCG company’s revenue from operations meanwhile increased 15.55% YoY to Rs 11,322.58 crore during the second quarter of FY27, from Rs 9,798.84 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year. Its total expenses rose around 18% YoY to Rs 10,997.51 crore during the quarter under review, from Rs 9,344.98 crore in the year-ago period.
